info.lobbyText: The lobby is your tower's entrance. Visitors arrive here and you use the elevator to guide them to their destinations.
info.guestsText: Guests head to floor 1 (Hotel) and check in as new workers. Guide them up to grow your team.
info.businessmenText: Businessmen pay in gems — one gem per visit, up to your daily limit. Lift them to any floor to collect.
info.deliverersText: Deliverers and sellers visit production floors to bring supplies or buyers. Lift them to earn coin tips.
info.tipsText: Every coin tip you collect counts toward your daily tip goal. Reach the two milestones to earn gem rewards.
info.deliverAllText: Spend 1 gem to instantly deliver all waiting visitors at once — great when the lobby is packed.
